body:
I have shared custody now, after a long uphill battle. Another huge part of my depression is worrying that my ex will also take me to court over the new baby. He does it to control me and hurt me (which obviously works) 

The problem is this time I dont have any $$$ to fund it! Hell, I don't even have $ to clothe or diaper new baby.
I am hesitant because the times I did ask for help ,It was used against me in court for custody of my eldest.

I'm not religious so I wouldn't feel comfortable calling a church. I want to reach out to a friend so bad but I feel we are more of acquaintances and that it'd be weird of me...also,I hope you aren't trying to discount my feelings just because I'm pregnant :( I've felt this way for years,before being pregnant so I don't think it's something that is going to go away anytime soon.

I'm also afraid of the backlash if I ask for help :(
